claims.claim: The Eldenpedia guide describes Avenue Balcony as a branch point and directs the player up the giant stone dragon wing toward Fortified Manor and Erdtree Sanctuary.
The Game8 walkthrough identifies the elevator west of the Erdtree Sanctuary boss room, the lower route, the railing jump and the giant spear as the acquisition sequence.
PC Gamer independently describes the Avenue Balcony, dragon wing, West Capital Rampart, root and Erdtree Sanctuary approach.

notes: Commercial guides are retained as evidence references only; their text, images and coordinates are not copied into the dataset.
The default route edges require the structured Eldenpedia claims plus this independent cross-check set.
